# FrameAssembly

> A Domain-Specific Language (DSL) compiler for writing deterministic network traffic to `.pcap` files.

## Overview
FrameAssembly compiles a custom networking DSL (.fasm) into reproducible
PCAP/PCAPNG (.pcap) files. It supports 81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7
protocols, full dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 polymorphism, zero-keyword RFC
defaults, fine-grained L2–L4 frame modifiers, and stateful TCP 4-tuple
sequence tracking and port inheritance. It is designed for network
technicians, security researchers, firewall/IDS validation, and LLM-driven
synthetic traffic generation.

## Unified Architecture Map
- `src/lib.rs`: Library crate root with backwards-compatible module re-exports.
- `src/main.rs`: CLI binary interface (`frameassembly <file.fasm> [-o out.pcap]`).
- `src/lexer/`: Zero-copy tokenizer built with Logos (`mod.rs`, `tests.rs`).
- `src/ast/`: Abstract Syntax Tree definitions:
  - `src/ast/mod.rs`: Root AST types (`Program`, `HostDef`, `FlowDef`, `ProtocolSpec`).
  - `src/ast/l2/`: Layer 2 protocol AST specs (`arp`, `vlan`, `qinq`, `lldp`, `stp`, `lacp`, `eapol`, `mpls`).
  - `src/ast/l3/`: Layer 3 protocol AST specs (20 protocols: `icmp`, `ndp`, `gre`, `ipsec`, `ospf`, `bgp`, etc.).
  - `src/ast/l4/`: Layer 4 transport AST specs (`tcp`, `udp`, `sctp`).
  - `src/ast/l7/`: Layer 7 application AST specs (47 protocols + `snmp`).
- `src/parser/`: Combinator-based AST parser built with Winnow:
  - `src/parser/mod.rs`: Core parser combinators, validation, and `parse_program`.
  - `src/parser/tests.rs`: Comprehensive parser unit tests.
  - `src/parser/l2/`: Layer 2 protocol parsers (`arp.rs`, `vlan.rs`, `qinq.rs`, etc.).
  - `src/parser/l3/`: Layer 3 protocol parsers (`icmp.rs`, `ndp.rs`, `gre.rs`, etc.).
  - `src/parser/l4/`: Layer 4 transport parsers (`tcp.rs`, `udp.rs`, `sctp.rs`).
  - `src/parser/l7/`: Layer 7 application parsers (`snmp.rs`, `dns.rs`, `http.rs`, etc.).
- `src/builders/`: Zero-heap packet builders and payload encoders:
  - `src/builders/mod.rs`: Module re-exports and backwards-compatible layer aliases.
  - `src/builders/l2/`: Layer 2 wire builders.
  - `src/builders/l3/`: Layer 3 tunnel and routing builders.
  - `src/builders/l4/`: Layer 4 transport builders.
  - `src/builders/l7/`: Layer 7 application builders and `snmp/` (builder & crypto).
- `src/backend/`: Frame IR lowering, 4-tuple TCP state tracking, timing (`mod.rs`, `tests.rs`).
- `src/packet.rs`: Etherparse network packet encapsulation.
- `src/pcap.rs`: Nanosecond-precision PCAPNG writer via `pcap-file 2.0`.
- `examples/`: Exhaustive 385-example verified corpus in dedicated `<layer>/<protocol>/` directories:
  - `examples/l2/`: 25 Layer 2 examples across 8 protocols.
  - `examples/l3/`: 60 Layer 3 examples across 20 protocols.
  - `examples/l4/`: 46 Layer 4 examples across 3 transports.
  - `examples/l7/`: 201 Layer 7 examples (141 across 47 protocols + 60 SNMP).
  - `examples/topologies/`: 53 multi-tier and cross-cutting network topologies.

## DSL Syntax & Core Keywords
- **Top-Level Declarations:**
  - `HOST <name> { IP <ipv4|ipv6> [MAC <mac>] }`: Defines endpoint host.
    Unspecified MAC is auto-derived (unicast, or RFC 2464 / RFC 1112 multicast).
  - `FLOW <name>(<param1>, <param2>) { <statements> }`: Defines flow template.
  - `COMPILE { <invocations> }`: Test execution block executing declared flows.
  - `LOOP <count> { <invocations> }`: High-volume packet generation loop.
- **Direction Operators:**
  - `A -> B`: Left-to-right transmission (A is source, B is destination).
  - `A <- B`: Right-to-left transmission (B is source, A is destination).
    Ports and TCP sequence numbers are automatically tracked and swapped.
- **Universal Modifiers:**
  - `WAIT <duration>`: Inter-frame delay (`ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, `m`).
  - `PAYLOAD "<string>"`: ASCII/UTF-8 payload with escape sequences.
  - `HEXPAYLOAD "<hex>"`: Raw binary hexadecimal byte payload.
- **Layer 2 Modifiers:**
  - `SRCMAC <mac>`, `DSTMAC <mac>`, `ETHERTYPE <u16>`
  - `VLAN <1..4094> [PCP <0..7>] [DEI <0..1>]`
  - `QINQ <1..4094> [INNER_VLAN <1..4094>]`
  - `MPLS <label> [EXP <0..7>] [BOS <0..1>] [MPLS_TTL <u8>]`
- **Layer 3 Modifiers:**
  - `TTL <0..255>`: IPv4 Time-To-Live or IPv6 Hop Limit.
  - `DSCP <0..63>`: Differentiated Services Code Point (QoS).
  - `ECN <0..3>`: Explicit Congestion Notification bits.
  - `FLOWLABEL <0..1048575>`: 20-bit IPv6 Flow Label (ignored on IPv4).
  - `IPID <u16>`, `DF`, `MF`, `FRAGOFFSET <u16>`: IPv4 fragmentation flags.
- **Layer 4 Modifiers:**
  - `SRCPORT <u16>`, `DSTPORT <u16>`: Transport layer port overrides.
  - `TRANSPORT TCP|UDP`: Explicit transport protocol selector.
  - `SEQ <u32>`, `ACKNUM <u32>`, `WIN <u16>`: Sequence, ack, window.
  - `MSS <u16>`, `WSCALE <u8>`, `SACK_PERM`: TCP options negotiation.
  - `TSVAL <u32>`, `TSECR <u32>`, `URGENT <u16>`: Timestamps and urgent.
  - TCP Flags: `SYN`, `ACK`, `FIN`, `RST`, `PSH`, `URG`, `ECE`, `CWR`.
- **SNMP Protocols & USM:**
  - PDU Types: `TRAP`, `INFORM`, `GET`, `GETNEXT`, `GETBULK`, `SET`, `RESPONSE`, `REPORT`.
  - Common Fields: `COMMUNITY "<str>"`, `OID <oid>`, `SYSUPTIME <u32>`, `REQID <u32>`.
  - SNMPv1 Fields: `ENTERPRISE <oid>`, `AGENTIP <ipv4>`, `GENTRAP <0..6>`, `SPECTRAP <u32>`.
  - SNMPv3 Fields: `USER "<str>"`, `ENGINEID "<hex>"`, `ENGINEBOOTS <u32>`, `ENGINETIME <u32>`.
  - SNMPv3 Security: `AUTH <MD5|SHA|SHA256|SHA384|SHA512> "<pass>"`, `PRIV <DES|AES> "<pass>"`.
  - Variable Bindings: `VARBIND <oid> <TYPE> <value>`:
    - `NULLVAL`: ASN.1 Null.
    - `STRING "<text>"`: OctetString.
    - `INT <signed_i32>`: Signed 32-bit Integer (supports negative numbers).
    - `TIMETICKS <u32>`: Hundredths of a second.
    - `IPVAL <ip>`: 4-byte IPv4 or 16-byte IPv6 address (RFC 4001).
    - `OIDVAL <oid>`: ASN.1 Object Identifier.
    - `COUNTER32 <u32>`, `GAUGE32 <u32>`, `COUNTER64 <u64>`.

## Comprehensive Protocol Keyword & Sub-Keyword Reference (All 81 Protocols)

### 1. Layer 2 Data Link Protocols (8 Protocols)

#### `ARP` (Address Resolution Protocol - RFC 826)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/arp/`](examples/l2/arp/)
- Sub-keywords: `REQUEST`, `REPLY`, `GRATUITOUS` / `GARP`, `SPA <ip>`, `THA
  <mac>`, `TPA <ip>`, `SENDERMAC <mac>`, `TARGETMAC <mac>`, `SENDERIP <ip>`,
  `TARGETIP <ip>`.
- Wire behavior: EtherType 0x0806, Hardware Type 1 (Ethernet), Protocol Type
  0x0800 (IPv4). Defaults to `REQUEST` asking for target IP.

#### `VLAN` (IEEE 802.1Q Virtual Bridged LANs)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/vlan/`](examples/l2/vlan/)
- Sub-keywords: `VLAN <1..4094>`, `PCP <0..7>`, `DEI <0..1>`.
- Wire behavior: Inserts 4-byte 802.1Q tag (EtherType 0x8100) before inner
  payload. Defaults to VLAN 100, PCP 0, DEI 0.

#### `QINQ` (IEEE 802.1ad Provider Bridging)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/qinq/`](examples/l2/qinq/)
- Sub-keywords: `QINQ <1..4094>`, `INNER_VLAN <1..4094>`, `PCP <0..7>`, `DEI
  <0..1>`.
- Wire behavior: Dual-tagged stack with 0x88A8 outer service tag and 0x8100
  inner customer tag.

#### `LLDP` (IEEE 802.1AB Link Layer Discovery Protocol)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/lldp/`](examples/l2/lldp/)
- Sub-keywords: `CHASSIS_ID "<str>"`, `PORT_ID "<str>"`, `TTL <u16>`,
  `SYSNAME "<str>"`, `SYSDESC "<str>"`.
- Wire behavior: EtherType 0x88CC to multicast `01:80:c2:00:00:0e`. Emits
  Chassis ID, Port ID, TTL (default 120s), and End TLVs.

#### `STP` (IEEE 802.1D Spanning Tree / 802.1w RSTP)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/stp/`](examples/l2/stp/)
- Sub-keywords: `ROOT_ID "<str>"`, `BRIDGE_ID "<str>"`, `COST <u32>`,
  `PORT_ID <u16>`, `MAX_AGE <u16>`, `HELLO_TIME <u16>`, `FORWARD_DELAY
  <u16>`, `RSTP`, `FLAGS <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: Emitted over LLC/SNAP to `01:80:c2:00:00:00`. Emits
  Configuration or RSTP BPDU.

#### `LACP` (IEEE 802.3ad Link Aggregation Control)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/lacp/`](examples/l2/lacp/)
- Sub-keywords: `ACTOR_SYS "<mac>"`, `ACTOR_KEY <u16>`, `ACTOR_PORT <u16>`,
  `PARTNER_SYS "<mac>"`, `PARTNER_KEY <u16>`, `PARTNER_PORT <u16>`,
  `ACTOR_STATE <u8>`, `PARTNER_STATE <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: Slow Protocols (EtherType 0x8809, Subtype 1) to
  `01:80:c2:00:00:02`.

#### `EAPOL` (IEEE 802.1X Port-Based Network Access Control)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/eapol/`](examples/l2/eapol/)
- Sub-keywords: `VERSION <u8>`, `TYPE <u8>`, `START`, `LOGOFF`, `KEY`,
  `EAP_PACKET`, `EAP_CODE <u8>`, `EAP_ID <u8>`, `EAP_METHOD <u8>`, `IDENTITY
  "<str>"`.
- Wire behavior: EtherType 0x888E. Defaults to EAP-Packet with EAP-
  Request/Response Identity.

#### `MPLS` (RFC 3031 / 3032 Multi-Protocol Label Switching)
- Directory: [`examples/l2/mpls/`](examples/l2/mpls/)
- Sub-keywords: `LABEL <u32>`, `EXP <0..7>`, `TC <0..7>`, `BOS <0..1>`,
  `MPLS_TTL <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: EtherType 0x8847. Emits 32-bit label stack entry (default
  Label 16, BOS 1, TTL 64).

### 2. Layer 3 Routing, Tunneling & Security Protocols (20 Protocols)

#### `ICMP` (Internet Control Message Protocol - RFC 792 / RFC 4443)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/icmp/`](examples/l3/icmp/)
- Sub-keywords: `ECHO_REQUEST`, `ECHO_REPLY`, `DEST_UNREACH`,
  `TIME_EXCEEDED`, `REDIRECT`, `CODE <u8>`, `ID <u16>`, `SEQ <u16>`,
  `GATEWAY <ip>`.
- Wire behavior: Polymorphic dual-stack (IPv4 protocol 1 or IPv6 protocol
  58). Defaults to Echo Request (ID 1, Seq 1).

#### `NDP` (IPv6 Neighbor Discovery - RFC 4861)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/ndp/`](examples/l3/ndp/)
- Sub-keywords: `ROUTER_SOLICIT`, `ROUTER_ADVERT`, `NEIGHBOR_SOLICIT`,
  `NEIGHBOR_ADVERT`, `TARGET <ipv6>`, `SLLA <mac>`, `TLLA <mac>`,
  `ROUTER_LIFETIME <u16>`.
- Wire behavior: ICMPv6 Type 135 Neighbor Solicitation to Solicited-Node
  Multicast (`ff02::1:ffxx:xxxx`), Hop Limit 255.

#### `IGMP` (Internet Group Management Protocol - RFC 2236 / RFC 3376)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/igmp/`](examples/l3/igmp/)
- Sub-keywords: `QUERY`, `REPORT`, `LEAVE`, `V1`, `V2`, `V3`, `GROUP
  <ipv4>`, `MAX_RESP <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: IPv4 protocol 2. Defaults to Membership Query to all-
  systems multicast `224.0.0.1`.

#### `MLD` (Multicast Listener Discovery for IPv6 - RFC 2710 / RFC 3810)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/mld/`](examples/l3/mld/)
- Sub-keywords: `QUERY`, `REPORT`, `DONE`, `V1`, `V2`, `MULTICAST_ADDR
  <ipv6>`, `MAX_RESP_DELAY <u16>`.
- Wire behavior: ICMPv6 Type 130 Listener Query to `ff02::1` with Router
  Alert hop-by-hop option.

#### `GRE` (Generic Routing Encapsulation - RFC 2784 / RFC 2890)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/gre/`](examples/l3/gre/)
- Sub-keywords: `CHECKSUM`, `GRE_KEY <u32>`, `GRE_SEQ <u32>`, `GRE_PROTO
  <u16>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 47. Encapsulates inner protocol payload
  (default EtherType 0x0800 or 0x86DD).

#### `VXLAN` (Virtual eXtensible Local Area Network - RFC 7348)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/vxlan/`](examples/l3/vxlan/)
- Sub-keywords: `VNI <u32>` / `VNID <u32>`, `SRCPORT <u16>`, `DSTPORT
  <u16>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 4789. Emits 8-byte VXLAN header with 24-bit VNI
  (default 1000) and inner Ethernet frame.

#### `GENEVE` (Generic Network Virtualization Encapsulation - RFC 8926)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/geneve/`](examples/l3/geneve/)
- Sub-keywords: `VNI <u32>`, `PROTOCOL_TYPE <u16>`, `OPT_CLASS <u16>`,
  `OPT_TYPE <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 6081. Emits GENEVE header with 24-bit VNI and
  EtherType 0x6558.

#### `IPSEC` (IP Security Architecture - RFC 4301)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/ipsec/`](examples/l3/ipsec/)
- Sub-keywords: `SPI <u32>`, `SEQ <u32>`, `IV "<hex>"`, `ICV "<hex>"`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 50 (ESP wrapper). SPI default 0x1000, sequence
  1.

#### `ESP` (Encapsulating Security Payload - RFC 4303)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/esp/`](examples/l3/esp/)
- Sub-keywords: `SPI <u32>`, `SEQ <u32>`, `IV "<hex>"`, `ICV "<hex>"`,
  `NEXT_HEADER <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 50. Encapsulates encrypted payload with SPI and
  sequence counter.

#### `AH` (IP Authentication Header - RFC 4302)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/ah/`](examples/l3/ah/)
- Sub-keywords: `SPI <u32>`, `SEQ <u32>`, `ICV "<hex>"`, `NEXT_HEADER <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 51. Emits SPI, sequence counter, and 96-bit ICV
  authentication tag.

#### `IKEV2` (Internet Key Exchange Protocol Version 2 - RFC 7296)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/ikev2/`](examples/l3/ikev2/)
- Sub-keywords: `INITIATOR_SPI "<hex>"`, `RESPONDER_SPI "<hex>"`, `EXCHANGE
  <u8>`, `SA_INIT`, `CREATE_CHILD_SA`, `INFORMATIONAL`, `MSGID <u32>`,
  `NEXT_PAYLOAD <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 500. Defaults to IKE_SA_INIT (Exchange Type 34).

#### `WIREGUARD` (WireGuard VPN Protocol)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/wireguard/`](examples/l3/wireguard/)
- Sub-keywords: `INITIATION`, `COOKIE`, `DATA`, `SENDER <u32>`, `RECEIVER
  <u32>`, `COUNTER <u64>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 51820. Defaults to Type 1 Handshake Initiation
  message.

#### `OSPF` (Open Shortest Path First - RFC 2328 / RFC 5340)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/ospf/`](examples/l3/ospf/)
- Sub-keywords: `HELLO`, `DBD`, `LSR`, `LSU`, `LSACK`, `ROUTER_ID <ip>`,
  `AREA_ID <ip>`, `HELLO_INTERVAL <u16>`, `DEAD_INTERVAL <u32>`, `PRIORITY
  <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 89. Emits OSPFv2 (IPv4) or OSPFv3 (IPv6) Hello
  packet to `224.0.0.5` / `ff02::5`.

#### `BGP` (Border Gateway Protocol 4 - RFC 4271 / RFC 2545)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/bgp/`](examples/l3/bgp/)
- Sub-keywords: `OPEN`, `UPDATE`, `NOTIFICATION`, `KEEPALIVE`, `ASN <u32>`,
  `HOLDTIME <u16>`, `BGPID <ip>`, `PREFIX "<cidr>"`, `NLRI "<cidr>"`,
  `NEXTHOP <ip>`.
- Wire behavior: TCP port 179. Defaults to BGP OPEN message with ASN 65001
  and Hold Time 180s.

#### `RIP` (Routing Information Protocol - RFC 2453 / RFC 2080)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/rip/`](examples/l3/rip/)
- Sub-keywords: `REQUEST`, `REPLY`, `COMMAND <u8>`, `VERSION <u8>`, `METRIC
  <u32>`, `TAG <u16>`, `PREFIX "<cidr>"`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 520 (RIPv2) or 521 (RIPng). Emits Route Table
  Response.

#### `VRRP` (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol - RFC 5798)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/vrrp/`](examples/l3/vrrp/)
- Sub-keywords: `VRID <u8>`, `PRIORITY <u8>`, `ADV_INT <u8>`, `VIP <ip>`,
  `VERSION <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 112 to `224.0.0.18` / `ff02::12`. Defaults to
  VRID 1, Priority 100.

#### `HSRP` (Cisco Hot Standby Router Protocol - RFC 2281)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/hsrp/`](examples/l3/hsrp/)
- Sub-keywords: `GROUP <u8>`, `PRIORITY <u8>`, `HELLOTIME <u8>`, `STATE
  <u8>`, `VIP <ip>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 1985 to `224.0.0.2`. Defaults to Hello message,
  State Active, Group 1.

#### `PIM` (Protocol Independent Multicast - RFC 7761)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/pim/`](examples/l3/pim/)
- Sub-keywords: `HELLO`, `JOIN_PRUNE`, `REGISTER`, `DR_PRIORITY <u32>`,
  `HOLDTIME <u16>`, `SOURCE <ip>`, `GROUP <ip>`, `RP <ip>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 103 to `224.0.0.13` / `ff02::d`. Defaults to
  Hello message.

#### `BFD` (Bidirectional Forwarding Detection - RFC 5880 / RFC 5881)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/bfd/`](examples/l3/bfd/)
- Sub-keywords: `STATE <u8>`, `DIAG <u8>`, `MY_DISC <u32>`, `YOUR_DISC
  <u32>`, `MIN_TX <u32>`, `MIN_RX <u32>`, `MULT <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 3784. Single-hop control packet, State Up, Detect
  Mult 3, Min TX/RX 1s.

#### `OPENFLOW` (OpenFlow Switch Protocol 1.3)
- Directory: [`examples/l3/openflow/`](examples/l3/openflow/)
- Sub-keywords: `HELLO`, `FEATURES_REQ`, `FEATURES_REPLY`, `PACKET_IN`,
  `PACKET_OUT`, `FLOW_MOD`, `ECHO_REQ`, `XID <u32>`, `DPID <u64>`, `TABLE_ID
  <u8>`.
- Wire behavior: TCP port 6653. OpenFlow Version 1.3 (0x04) OFPT_HELLO, XID
  1.

### 3. Layer 4 Transport Protocols (3 Protocols)

#### `TCP` (Transmission Control Protocol - RFC 793 / RFC 7323)
- Directory: [`examples/l4/tcp/`](examples/l4/tcp/)
- Sub-keywords: `SYN`, `ACK`, `FIN`, `RST`, `PSH`, `URG`, `ECE`, `CWR`,
  `SRCPORT <u16>`, `DSTPORT <u16>`, `SEQ <u32>`, `ACKNUM <u32>`, `WIN
  <u16>`, `WINDOW <u16>`, `MSS <u16>`, `WSCALE <u8>`, `SACK_PERM`, `TSVAL
  <u32>`, `TSECR <u32>`, `URGENT <u16>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 6, default destination port 80. Automatic
  4-tuple tracking, port inheritance, and sequence number progression across
  requests and replies.

#### `UDP` (User Datagram Protocol - RFC 768)
- Directory: [`examples/l4/udp/`](examples/l4/udp/)
- Sub-keywords: `SRCPORT <u16>`, `DSTPORT <u16>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 17, default destination port 80. Stateless
  transport header with automatic length and RFC 768 checksum calculation.

#### `SCTP` (Stream Control Transmission Protocol - RFC 4960)
- Directory: [`examples/l4/sctp/`](examples/l4/sctp/)
- Sub-keywords: `VTAG <u32>`, `CHECKSUM <u32>`, `CHUNK <type>`, `INIT`,
  `INIT_ACK`, `SACK`, `HEARTBEAT`, `HEARTBEAT_ACK`, `ABORT`, `SHUTDOWN`,
  `COOKIE_ECHO`, `COOKIE_ACK`, `TSN <u32>`, `STREAM <u16>`, `SSN <u16>`,
  `PPID <u32>`.
- Wire behavior: IP protocol 132, default destination port 80. Common header
  with Verification Tag and DATA chunk, verified with CRC32c checksum.

### 4. Layer 7 Application, Telemetry, Storage & Industrial Protocols (50 Protocols)

#### `SNMP1` (Simple Network Management Protocol v1 - RFC 1157)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/snmp/snmpv1/`](examples/l7/snmp/snmpv1/)
- Sub-keywords: `TRAP`, `GET`, `SET`, `RESPONSE`, `GETNEXT`, `COMMUNITY
  "<str>"`, `OID <oid>`, `SYSUPTIME <u32>`, `ENTERPRISE <oid>`, `AGENTIP
  <ipv4>`, `GENTRAP <0..6>`, `SPECTRAP <u32>`, `VARBIND`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 162 (Trap) / 161 (Get/Set). Emits RFC 1157 SMIv1
  ASN.1 BER encoded messages.

#### `SNMP2` (Simple Network Management Protocol v2c - RFC 3416)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/snmp/snmpv2c/`](examples/l7/snmp/snmpv2c/)
- Sub-keywords: `TRAP`, `INFORM`, `GET`, `GETNEXT`, `GETBULK`, `SET`,
  `RESPONSE`, `COMMUNITY "<str>"`, `OID <oid>`, `SYSUPTIME <u32>`, `REQID
  <u32>`, `NONREPEATERS <u32>`, `MAXREPETITIONS <u32>`, `VARBIND`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 162 / 161. Emits RFC 3416 SMIv2 BER encoded PDUs
  with 64-bit counter support.

#### `SNMP3` (Simple Network Management Protocol v3 - RFC 3414)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/snmp/snmpv3/`](examples/l7/snmp/snmpv3/)
- Sub-keywords: `TRAP`, `INFORM`, `GET`, `GETNEXT`, `GETBULK`, `SET`,
  `RESPONSE`, `REPORT`, `USER "<str>"`, `ENGINEID "<hex>"`, `ENGINEBOOTS
  <u32>`, `ENGINETIME <u32>`, `CONTEXTNAME "<str>"`, `AUTH
  <MD5|SHA|SHA256|SHA384|SHA512> "<pass>"`, `PRIV <DES|AES> "<pass>"`,
  `VARBIND`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 161/162. Complete User-Based Security Model (USM)
  with authentication (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512) and privacy
  encryption (DES-CBC, AES-128-CFB).
- Variable Bindings: `VARBIND <oid> <TYPE> <value>`:
- `NULLVAL` / `NULL`: Null ASN.1 value
- `STRING "<text>"`: OctetString value
- `INT <signed_i32>`: Signed 32-bit Integer (supports negative numbers, e.g.
  `-15`)
- `TIMETICKS <u32>`: Hundredths of a second
- `IPVAL <ip>`: 4-byte IPv4 or 16-byte IPv6 address per RFC 4001
- `OIDVAL <oid>`: ASN.1 Object Identifier
- `COUNTER32 <u32>`: Unsigned 32-bit counter
- `GAUGE32 <u32>`: Unsigned 32-bit gauge
- `COUNTER64 <u64>`: Unsigned 64-bit high-capacity counter

#### `DNS` (Domain Name System - RFC 1035)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/dns/`](examples/l7/dns/)
- Sub-keywords: `TXID <u16>`, `QNAME "<name>"`, `QTYPE <u16>`, `RDATA
  "<str>"`, `RCODE <u8>`, `ANS_TTL <u32>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 53. Standard query or answer (Type 1 A, Type 28
  AAAA, etc.).

#### `MDNS` (Multicast DNS - RFC 6762)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/mdns/`](examples/l7/mdns/)
- Sub-keywords: Same as DNS, plus UDP port 5353 and multicast destination
  `224.0.0.251` / `ff02::fb`.

#### `DHCP` (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol - RFC 2131 / RFC 8415)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/dhcp/`](examples/l7/dhcp/)
- Sub-keywords: `DISCOVER`, `OFFER`, `REQUEST`, `RELEASE`, `SOLICIT`,
  `ADVERTISE`, `TXID <u32>`, `CIADDR <ip>`, `YIADDR <ip>`, `SIADDR <ip>`,
  `CHADDR <mac>`, `HOSTNAME "<str>"`, `DNS_SERVER <ip>`, `ROUTER <ip>`,
  `SUBNET_MASK <ip>`, `LEASE_TIME <u32>`.
- Wire behavior: UDP port 67/68 (IPv4 BOOTP) or UDP port 546/547 (DHCPv6).

#### `NTP` (Network Time Protocol - RFC 5905)
- Directory: [`examples/l7/ntp/`](examples/l7/ntp/)
- Sub-keywords: `LI <0..3>`, `VN <0..7>`, `MODE <0..7>`, `STRATUM <u8>`,
  `POLL <u8>`, `PRECISION <i8>`, `REFID "<str>"`, `TX_TIMESTAMP <u64>`.

  Communication between IPv6 loopback and unspecified addresses to test

- [examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_global_ff0e.fasm](examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_global_ff0e.fasm):
  IPv6 global scope multicast transmission to ff0e::101 deriving RFC 2464
  Ethernet MAC.
- [examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_mac_all_nodes.fasm](examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_mac_all_nodes.fasm):
  IPv6 all-nodes multicast transmission automatically deriving RFC 2464 MAC
  33:33:00:00:00:01.
- [examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_mac_all_routers.fasm](examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_mac_all_routers.fasm):
  IPv6 all-routers multicast transmission automatically deriving RFC 2464
  MAC 33:33:00:00:00:02.
- [examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_site_local_dhcpv6.fasm](examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_site_local_dhcpv6.fasm):
  IPv6 site-local DHCPv6 server multicast transmission to ff05::1:3 deriving
  RFC 2464 MAC.
- [examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_solicited_node.fasm](examples/topologies/ipv6_multicast_solicited_node.fasm):
  IPv6 solicited-node multicast transmission deriving RFC 2464 MAC
  33:33:ff:00:12:34.
- [examples/topologies/l3_dscp_network_control_scavenger.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_dscp_network_control_scavenger.fasm):
  Network control and scavenger traffic classes spanning CS6, CS7, CS1, and
  boundary values 0 and 63.
- [examples/topologies/l3_dscp_signaling_and_bulk_data.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_dscp_signaling_and_bulk_data.fasm):
  Quality of Service DSCP classification across signaling AF31, low-latency
  AF21, and bulk AF11.
- [examples/topologies/l3_dscp_voice_video_ef_af41.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_dscp_voice_video_ef_af41.fasm):
  Differentiated Services Code Point QoS marking for Expedited Forwarding
  voice and AF41 video.
- [examples/topologies/l3_ecn_and_ip_fragmentation.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_ecn_and_ip_fragmentation.fasm):
  Explicit Congestion Notification and IPv4 fragmentation control flags
  including DF, MF, and FRAGOFFSET.
- [examples/topologies/l3_flowlabel_boundary_values.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_flowlabel_boundary_values.fasm):
  IPv6 FLOWLABEL field boundary testing using minimum value 0 and maximum
  20-bit value 1048575.
- [examples/topologies/l3_flowlabel_ecmp_multipath_hashing.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_flowlabel_ecmp_multipath_hashing.fasm):
  IPv6 20-bit FLOWLABEL generation across parallel traffic streams for ECMP
  multipath distribution.
- [examples/topologies/l3_flowlabel_ipv4_silent_ignore.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_flowlabel_ipv4_silent_ignore.fasm):
  Polymorphic flow specifying FLOWLABEL executed over both IPv4 and IPv6
  where IPv4 silently ignores the modifier.
- [examples/topologies/l3_ttl_bgp_gtsm_and_zero_edge.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_ttl_bgp_gtsm_and_zero_edge.fasm):
  Generalized TTL Security Mechanism with maximum TTL 255 and boundary edge
  case TTL 0.
- [examples/topologies/l3_ttl_hop_limits_traceroute.fasm](examples/topologies/l3_ttl_hop_limits_traceroute.fasm):
  Traceroute simulation with incremental TTL hop limit values 1, 2, and 3.
- [examples/topologies/minimal_single_frame_baseline.fasm](examples/topologies/minimal_single_frame_baseline.fasm):
  Minimalist baseline FrameAssembly program defining two hosts, a single-
  statement TCP SYN flow using all default field values, and a single
  compile invocation.
- [examples/topologies/multi_arg_flow_mesh_orchestration.fasm](examples/topologies/multi_arg_flow_mesh_orchestration.fasm):
  Demonstrate a 5-parameter FLOW orchestrating full-mesh east-west
  microservice heartbeats across five distinct hosts.
- [examples/topologies/multi_loop_staged_load_test.fasm](examples/topologies/multi_loop_staged_load_test.fasm):
  Simulate a multi-stage load test using sequential LOOP blocks in the
  COMPILE section representing warm-up, peak burst, and cool-down traffic
  phases.
- [examples/topologies/multicast_explicit_mac_override.fasm](examples/topologies/multicast_explicit_mac_override.fasm):
  Multicast endpoint declaration with explicit MAC override taking
  precedence over auto-derivation.
- [examples/topologies/snmp_tri_version_coexistence_audit.fasm](examples/topologies/snmp_tri_version_coexistence_audit.fasm):
  Simulate a brownfield network management audit where legacy SNMPv1,
  standard SNMPv2c, and encrypted SNMPv3 coexist and report to a single
  compliance collector.
- [examples/topologies/topology_carrier_mpls_vpn_pe_ce.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_carrier_mpls_vpn_pe_ce.fasm):
  Service provider BGP/MPLS IP VPN routing between Customer Edge (CE) and
  Provider Edge (PE) routers.
- [examples/topologies/topology_datacenter_vxlan_evpn_underlay.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_datacenter_vxlan_evpn_underlay.fasm):
  Data center network fabric running BGP-EVPN control plane with VXLAN
  encapsulation over IPv6 underlay.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dmz_firewall_intrusion_alert.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dmz_firewall_intrusion_alert.fasm):
  Simulate an external attacker scanning a DMZ firewall (SYN, FIN+PSH+URG),
  the firewall blocking with RST ACK, and alerting a SOC SIEM via Syslog UDP
  and SNMPv3 INFORM.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dns_amplification_and_mitigation.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dns_amplification_and_mitigation.fasm):
  Simulate a UDP DNS ANY amplification attack against a victim server
  followed by an automated DDoS scrubbing center BGP FlowSpec mitigation
  rule and SNMPv2c trap.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_dns_web_tier.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_dns_web_tier.fasm):
  Multi-tier web service deployment resolving DNS records followed by TLS
  1.3 and HTTP/2 session establishment.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_kubernetes_service_mesh.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_kubernetes_service_mesh.fasm):
  Kubernetes dual-stack service mesh traffic routing between microservices
  via HTTP/2 and gRPC.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_leaf_spine_fabric.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_leaf_spine_fabric.fasm):
  Dual-stack data center Clos leaf-spine fabric with BGP peering and VXLAN
  overlay encapsulation.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_voip_qos_telemetry.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_voip_qos_telemetry.fasm):
  Enterprise VoIP deployment combining SIP signaling (DSCP 26), RTP audio
  streams (DSCP 46), and SNMP telemetry.
- [examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_wan_sdwan_failover.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_dual_stack_wan_sdwan_failover.fasm):
  SD-WAN multi-tenant IPsec tunnel health monitoring using BFD heartbeat
  probes across IPv4 and IPv6 links.
- [examples/topologies/topology_enterprise_campus_dot1x_nac.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_enterprise_campus_dot1x_nac.fasm):
  Enterprise campus zero-trust port onboarding with 802.1X EAPOL, RADIUS
  authentication, and DHCP IP assignment.
- [examples/topologies/topology_industrial_scada_modbus_monitoring.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_industrial_scada_modbus_monitoring.fasm):
  Simulate an Industrial Control System (ICS/SCADA) HMI polling a
  Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) over Modbus/TCP port 502 alongside
  SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c thermal alerts.
- [examples/topologies/topology_industrial_scada_substation.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_industrial_scada_substation.fasm):
  Power grid electrical substation automation integrating Modbus, DNP3, and
  S7comm telemetry.
- [examples/topologies/topology_kubernetes_pod_service_mesh.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_kubernetes_pod_service_mesh.fasm):
  Simulate a Kubernetes cluster pod-to-pod service mesh workflow combining
  CoreDNS UDP service discovery, Envoy mTLS TCP gRPC calls, and node SNMPv2c
  scraping.
- [examples/topologies/topology_spine_leaf_datacenter.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_spine_leaf_datacenter.fasm):
  Simulate a data center Clos spine-leaf fabric combining eBGP TCP peering
  on port 179, VXLAN UDP overlay frames on port 4789, and SNMPv3 fabric
  health traps.
- [examples/topologies/topology_three_tier_web_app.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_three_tier_web_app.fasm):
  Simulate a 4-host three-tier web application architecture (External Client
  -> Reverse Proxy Load Balancer -> App Server -> Database Server) in a
  single multi-parameter flow.
- [examples/topologies/topology_voip_call_with_qos_telemetry.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_voip_call_with_qos_telemetry.fasm):
  Simulate an enterprise VoIP call combining SIP UDP signaling (port 5060),
  RTP UDP voice packets (port 16384), and voice gateway SNMPv3 QoS jitter
  and MOS score monitoring.
- [examples/topologies/topology_wan_sdwan_failover_simulation.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_wan_sdwan_failover_simulation.fasm):
  Simulate an SD-WAN primary circuit failure detected via Bidirectional
  Forwarding Detection (BFD) on UDP port 3784, triggering an SNMPv2c
  linkDown trap and TCP tunnel failover.
- [examples/topologies/topology_zero_trust_inspection_pipeline.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_zero_trust_inspection_pipeline.fasm):
  Comprehensive perimeter security inspection chain traversing next-gen
  firewall, TLS proxy, and SIEM Syslog.
- [examples/topologies/topology_zero_trust_proxy_inspection.fasm](examples/topologies/topology_zero_trust_proxy_inspection.fasm):
  Simulate a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) policy enforcement flow
  combining TLS TCP client access, RADIUS UDP MFA verification, and backend
  TCP proxy forwarding.

## Relevant Files
- [README.md](README.md) - Full documentation and language specification.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) - Full context bundle with formal EBNF grammar, AST definitions, and all 385 example scripts.
- [demo.fasm](demo.fasm) - Primary demonstration script.
- [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs) - Library crate root and re-exports.
- [src/ast/mod.rs](src/ast/mod.rs) - Core structural AST types.
